cards.name: Anti-Aircraft Flower
cards.officialText: By tributing 1 Insect-Type monster on your side of the field, inflict 800 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

cards.name: Arcane Archer of the Forest
cards.officialText: While there is a Plant-Type monster on your side of the field, this card cannot be attacked. By tributing 1 Plant-Type monster on your side of the field, destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

rulingsAndImplementationNotes.note: A controller may Tribute their own face-down monster for a cost requiring a specific Type; selection remains private to that controller.
The effect selects a Spell/Trap on the field; face-down Spell/Trap cards remain eligible. The helper retains the selected physical UID through resolution.

implementationScope: Pure helper module and isolated tests only. No resolver, catalog, certification, command, persistence or Discord handler integration.
certificationGate: Do not certify until the effect is registered in the production resolver and exercised through the 2v2 Discord handler with physical-owner, team-routing, privacy and persistence invariants.
